title: Jailer 2 streams on Prime Video from 12 Nov in five languages, in India and 240+ countries
headline: ₹800-Crore Jailer 2 Streams on Prime Video From 12 Nov
caption:
Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 streams on Prime Video from Thursday, 12 November, four weeks after it opened in cinemas on 15 October. Prime Video India says it will stream in Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam and Kannada, in India and in more than 240 countries and territories.

The first Jailer (2023) is already on Prime Video, so both films will be on one service. Nelson Dilipkumar directed the sequel and Sun Pictures produced it.

Trade trackers put Jailer 2's worldwide gross above ₹800 crore, the most for any Tamil film so far.

Did you see Jailer 2 in a theatre, or were you waiting for it to stream?

Sources: The Hollywood Reporter India, DT Next, Gulf News, Khaleej Times, The Week
